description.zh: ETL任务ID，您可以调用[DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~)接口查询任务ID。
description.en: The ID of the ETL task. You can call the [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) operation to query the task ID.

description.zh: DTS实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)接口查询阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the DTS instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the list of Alibaba Cloud regions.
